verdict_condition: proceed ONLY with Stage 5I's definition of done widened to cover G-A, G-B and G-D as well as G-C. A provider-only 5I would reproduce exactly the narrow-fix pattern this audit exists to break.

gaps.surface: live slot bypasses admission, caps, freshness and explain
gaps.expected: a shadow day must exercise the same admission the replay does, or it proves the detector fires rather than that the route would have traded
gaps.found: observe_live_slot calls NONE of fresh.evaluate / run_candidates / make_guard / emit_explanations; run_shadow calls all four. Confirmed by AST and by tracing a slot with a stub provider: track1_signal_layer, track1_freshness, track1_explain and track1_switch are NEVER entered
gaps.risk: with a provider added, slots would record decided=true having applied no cluster cap, no family cap, no same-symbol suppression and no freshness gate, and would leave no explanation trail; the collected evidence would not describe the route that would trade
gaps.action: fold into Stage 5I's definition of done, or a stage immediately after and before shadow start

gaps.surface: window ledger rows are stamped route=legacy
gaps.expected: Track 1 coverage evidence must be attributable to track1_candidate
gaps.found: the scheduler sets RAITS_ROUTE=legacy for Track 1 slots; window_ledger.route() reads it, so window_open/slot_observed/window_closed all carry route='legacy'. Only window_open carries route_hint='track1_candidate'; the other two carry no route identity at all
gaps.risk: precondition 5 evidence is filed under legacy; anything splitting by route folds Track 1 in, which is the documented 'route field added but downstream aggregation folds Track1 into legacy' pattern
gaps.action: set RAITS_ROUTE for Track 1 slots, or have the ledger take the route explicitly

gaps.expected: a slot can obtain today's bars
gaps.found: main()'s live-shadow branch calls observe_live_slot without a provider; the entry point's nine flags contain no --bar-provider; build_bar_provider has no caller on the scheduler path
gaps.risk: every slot records no_bar_provider; no coverage, no checkpoint
gaps.action: Stage 5I - confirmed, and it is not the whole of 5I

gaps.expected: a connected broker is released when the slot ends
gaps.found: build_bar_provider returns (provider, broker) for that purpose; no caller, so no finally exists
gaps.risk: a leaked IB connection per slot, 25 slots a day, competing for client id
gaps.action: Stage 5I must add the finally alongside the wire

gaps.surface: ledger filename is UTC, records are ET session day
gaps.expected: an operator can find today's coverage file
gaps.found: session 2026-08-24 wrote window_coverage_20260823.jsonl; read_day() filters on the record's own date field, so code is correct and only the human view is confusing
gaps.risk: an operator concludes no coverage was written
gaps.action: already noted in the Stage 5H report; keep in the runbook

gaps.expected: the operator knows a start is not inert
gaps.found: runs before start; on a weekday after 09:31 ET it reads the broker; STOP_TRADING does not prevent it
gaps.risk: an unexpected broker read at start
gaps.action: documented in Stage 5H; keep in the operator checklist

gaps.expected: legacy verified flat at the broker
gaps.risk: a working stop with no position fills into a position nobody asked for

gaps.expected: track1_explain must not reach monitor/dashboard files
gaps.found: monitor/test_schedule_status_track1_20260823.py, created by another session, mentions track1_explain and trips that session's own guard
gaps.risk: none for Track 1 runtime; a red suite obscures real reds
gaps.action: owned by the session that created the monitor file

stage5i_must_include: --bar-provider {none,ibkr} parsed and used by the live-shadow branch (G-C)
the live slot exercising the same admission/caps/freshness the replay does, or an explicit written decision that a shadow day deliberately measures detection only (G-A)
